subject: physical-education
essentialQuestion: How can understanding target and striking/fielding activities help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain aim and force in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of consistency routines.
Apply striking technique in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving fielding coverage; correct it and explain why.
Connect aim and force with risk and safety. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Design a progressive practice and apply it in an individual or small-team challenge.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.
